name: Dino Tycoon
desc:
Hey! We invite you to play Dino Tycoon. Build your own dinosaur zoo. What are you waiting for?

Create prehistoric chaos as you add dinosaur after dinosaur to your growing zoo in Zoo Tycoon🌴!

Dinosaur Excavations Expansion Pack! Players let their imaginations run wild as they build the most incredible zoo filled with dinosaurs and tremendous beasts from the ice age. Control over 20 impressive new creatures, including a Tyrannosaurus rex, a velociraptor, and even a saber-toothed tiger. Players who can keep their animals and guests happy reach the ultimate Park Tycoon status. 🦕🦖🌴!

🏷️ Tags: Build, Dinosaur, Famous, Dino, Role Play, T-Rex,Tycoon
